rows.quote: We screened 2408 phenotypes from 44 categories in the Finnish database (R10 version), which comprised 412,181 individuals.
rows.coder_note: The sentence gives the R10 version together with the exact sample size of that one dictionary row; the other passage gives the same version. The row had no listed candidate.

The table rows give several different accessions for different phenotypes, some sourced from one cohort and some from two; they do not together identify one dictionary row, and the stated population conflicts with the one row whose accession range some of them fall in.
